description: crate-jmap-contacts-types/PLAN.md lines 28, 165-172, 300 reference a 'string_enum.rs' module containing a 'string_enum!' macro for open-ended string-typed enums. No such file exists in src/. Trigger: a contributor reading PLAN.md as guidance, attempting to use the documented macro. Bad behavior: dead path; the contributor patches the PLAN to remove the reference, or adds an enum that drifts from the actual codebase convention. PLAN.md is supposed to be a permanent design doc, not a scratchpad (workspace AGENTS.md). Either delete the references (the macro is not used) or implement the module. Recommended fix: delete the string_enum references from PLAN.md — kind / version / @type are all kept as Option<String> per the workspace 'externally-owned-schema classifier strings are EXCLUDED' rule in workspace AGENTS.md, so the macro is not needed.
